title: Jude and the Vow
author: August Eastwick
blurb: Odile Brightwater, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
